primary_pass_fail_metrics.description: Requirement model and use-case model pass their syntax validators.
Logical model passes XCom compilation. If the available summary only reports compile+run together, status=pass is accepted as compile pass.
Physical model passes XCom compilation. If the available summary only reports compile+run together, status=pass is accepted as compile pass.

llm_judge_metrics.description: Whether logical subsystem decomposition, ports, states, transitions, and connections are reasonable for the requirement.
Whether physical components, boundaries, sensors, actuators, controllers/evaluators, and interfaces are reasonable and traceable.
Whether logical simulation events, mode changes, and state transitions match the requirement rather than being empty or merely formal.
Whether physical variables, equations, disturbances, boundary conditions, and response directions have plausible physical meaning.

Whether the physical model faithfully refines the logical model through consistent subsystem-to-component mapping, interfaces/signals, event scenarios, control objectives, monitored quantities, and simulation variables.

secondary_recorded_metrics.description: Number of internal repair loops used before final result.
Total execution time for the task.
Total LLM calls issued by the group for the task, when available.
Total prompt and completion tokens, when available.

aggregation_plan.hard_success_rate: percentage of tasks passing all three pass/fail metrics
aggregation_plan.per_metric_pass_rate: percentage of tasks passing each individual hard metric
aggregation_plan.llm_judge_report: mean and standard deviation for each 1-5 LLM judge metric after anonymizing group labels; report both valid-output-only means and all-task means that include missing final outputs as score 1
aggregation_plan.efficiency_report: median and interquartile range for time, calls, tokens, and repairs when available
